pages.title: A Fairy's Wings
pages.text: A copy of a fairy's wings. Ger off the ground and they will hold you there — a slow hover rather than a flight. Not quite fast but enough to cross complex terrain.$(br2)Side effect is that they make you weaker.

pages.title: Cirno's Wings
pages.text: A copy of Cirno's wings, cut from ice crystals and copied just as faithfully. They lift you higher than the fairy's.$(br2)Their side effect makes you dumber.
